ConditionBuilder.Name: Visual Condition Builder
ConditionBuilder.Hint: Edit the conditions of active effects and their changes with menus instead of JSON. You can still switch to the JSON editor from the builder.

Builder.Title: Conditions
Builder.IntroRoll: This change only applies to {roll} that match these conditions. Without conditions it always applies.
Builder.IntroEffect: The whole effect is suppressed while these conditions don't match. They are checked against the actor, not against a roll.
Builder.IntroGeneric: The change only applies when these conditions match. Without conditions it always applies.
Builder.Unreadable: These conditions aren't valid JSON, so they open in the JSON editor.

Advantage.Label: Advantage
Advantage.Hint: Adds a source of advantage. Advantage and disadvantage from different sources cancel each other out.

Disadvantage.Label: Disadvantage
Disadvantage.Hint: Adds a source of disadvantage. Advantage and disadvantage from different sources cancel each other out.

ForceAdvantage.Label: Always advantage
ForceAdvantage.Hint: The roll has advantage, whatever other sources say.

ForceDisadvantage.Label: Always disadvantage
ForceDisadvantage.Hint: The roll has disadvantage, whatever other sources say.

NoDisadvantage.Label: Can't have disadvantage
NoDisadvantage.Hint: Disadvantage from other sources is ignored. Advantage still works.

NoAdvantage.Label: Can't have advantage
NoAdvantage.Hint: Advantage from other sources is ignored. Disadvantage still works.

Attributes.Title: Attributes
Attributes.Intro: Choose an attribute on the left to see what it does, which change type to use and what value it expects.
Attributes.TypeWarning: {type} usually doesn't fit this attribute. Use {recommended}.

Value.formula: A formula. Roll data like @prof or @abilities.dex.mod and dice work.
Value.mode: 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage, 0 for a normal roll.
Value.set: One entry per change. With Add it's added; with Subtract, or Add with a leading minus (-fire), it's removed.
Value.acFormula: A formula, or a JSON object with formula, label, armored and shielded.

abilityScore.Label: Ability score
abilityScore.Tip: Upgrade or Override sets the score. Add raises it, and "2 <= 20" adds 2 but not above 20.

abilityMax.Label: Ability score maximum
abilityMax.Tip: Raises the highest score the ability can reach, e.g. 22 for an epic boon.

abilityCheckMode.Label: Ability check advantage
abilityCheckMode.Tip: Add gives one source of advantage (1) or disadvantage (-1). Override forces it. Upgrade with 0 prevents disadvantage, Downgrade with 0 prevents advantage.

abilitySaveMode.Label: Saving throw advantage
abilitySaveMode.Tip: Add gives one source of advantage (1) or disadvantage (-1). Override forces it. Upgrade with 0 prevents disadvantage, Downgrade with 0 prevents advantage.

abilityAttackMode.Label: Attack advantage with this ability
abilityAttackMode.Tip: Applies to attack rolls that use this ability. 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage.

allChecksMode.Label: All ability checks: advantage
allChecksMode.Tip: Covers every ability, skill and tool check. 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage.

allChecksProficiency.Label: All ability checks: minimum proficiency
allChecksProficiency.Tip: 0.5 adds half proficiency to checks without proficiency, like Jack of All Trades.

allSavesMode.Label: All saving throws: advantage
allSavesMode.Tip: 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage on every saving throw.

skillMode.Label: Skill check advantage
skillMode.Tip: 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage. Upgrade with 0 prevents disadvantage.

skillProficiency.Label: Skill proficiency
skillProficiency.Tip: Upgrade only raises the level, so a better proficiency from elsewhere stays. 2 is expertise.

skillMinimum.Label: Skill check minimum roll
skillMinimum.Tip: Upgrade to 10 so the d20 counts as at least 10, like Reliable Talent.

allSkillsMode.Label: All skill checks: advantage
allSkillsMode.Tip: 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage on every skill check.

allSkillsProficiency.Label: All skill checks: minimum proficiency
allSkillsProficiency.Tip: 0.5 adds half proficiency to skills without proficiency.

toolProficiency.Label: Tool proficiency
toolProficiency.Tip: Upgrade only raises the level. Works even if the character doesn't list the tool yet. 2 is expertise.

allToolsProficiency.Label: All tool checks: minimum proficiency
allToolsProficiency.Tip: 0.5 adds half proficiency to tools without proficiency.

attackBonus.Label: Attack roll bonus by attack type

attackMode.Label: Attack advantage by attack type
attackMode.Tip: 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage on this kind of attack.

allAttacksMode.Label: All attack rolls: advantage
allAttacksMode.Tip: 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage on every attack roll.

damageBonus.Label: Damage bonus by attack type
damageBonus.Tip: Put the damage type in brackets after the dice, e.g. 1d6[fire] or @abilities.cha.mod[radiant].

acFormula.Label: Armor class formula
acFormula.Tip: Adds a way to calculate AC; the highest valid one is used. As JSON you can restrict it, e.g. {"formula": "10 + @abilities.dex.mod + @abilities.con.mod", "armored": false, "label": "Unarmored Defense"}.

damageResistance.Label: Damage resistance
damageResistance.Tip: Use ALL for every damage type.

damageImmunity.Label: Damage immunity
damageImmunity.Tip: Use ALL for every damage type.

damageVulnerability.Label: Damage vulnerability
damageVulnerability.Tip: Use ALL for every damage type.

damageModification.Label: Damage taken modification
damageModification.Tip: Added to damage of this type the creature takes. Negative numbers reduce it, e.g. -3 like Heavy Armor Master.

conditionImmunity.Label: Condition immunity
conditionImmunity.Tip: The creature can't gain this condition.

hpTempMax.Label: Temporary maximum hit points
hpTempMax.Tip: Raises or lowers the maximum without healing. Never change current or temporary hit points with an effect.

hpBonusLevel.Label: Hit point bonus per level
hpBonusLevel.Tip: Multiplied by the character level, e.g. 2 for the Tough feat.

hpThreshold.Label: Damage threshold
hpThreshold.Tip: Damage below this amount is ignored.

hpMax.Label: Hit point maximum
hpMax.Tip: Only for NPCs. For characters, use the bonuses instead.

speed.Label: Speed
speed.Tip: Upgrade only raises it, so a higher speed from elsewhere wins. A speed can only refer to speeds calculated before it, e.g. a fly speed may use the walking speed.

speedBonus.Label: Bonus to all speeds
speedBonus.Tip: Added to every speed the creature has.

speedMultiplier.Label: Speed multiplier
speedMultiplier.Tip: Multiplies every speed, e.g. 2 doubles it, 0.5 halves it.

ignoredTerrain.Label: Ignores difficult terrain
ignoredTerrain.Tip: Use all or nonmagical to ignore it entirely, or a terrain type for just that kind.

senseRange.Label: Sense range
senseRange.Tip: Upgrade sets the range or raises it if the creature already has the sense. Override sets it exactly.

size.Label: Size
size.Tip: Override sets the size. Upgrade only makes the creature larger.

weaponProficiency.Label: Weapon proficiency
weaponProficiency.Tip: sim and mar give all simple or martial weapons, or pick a single weapon.

weaponMastery.Label: Weapon mastery
weaponMastery.Tip: Gives the mastery property of this weapon.

weaponMasteryBonus.Label: Additional mastery property
weaponMasteryBonus.Tip: An extra mastery property for weapons whose mastery the character already has.

armorProficiency.Label: Armor proficiency
armorProficiency.Tip: lgt, med, hvy for light, medium, heavy armor, shl for shields.

initiativeMode.Label: Initiative advantage
initiativeMode.Tip: 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage on initiative.

concentrationMode.Label: Concentration save advantage
concentrationMode.Tip: 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage on concentration saves.

deathSaveMode.Label: Death save advantage
deathSaveMode.Tip: 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage on death saves.

encumbranceMultiplier.Label: Carrying capacity multiplier
encumbranceMultiplier.Tip: 2 doubles the threshold, like Powerful Build.

scaleValue.Label: Scale value
scaleValue.Tip: Changes a scale value of a class, subclass or other feature, e.g. Rages of the Barbarian. The character's own scale values come first, with their current values.

scaleNumber.Label: Scale value: number of dice
scaleNumber.Tip: For dice scale values, e.g. +1 turns 3d6 sneak attack into 4d6.

scaleFaces.Label: Scale value: die size
scaleFaces.Tip: For dice scale values, e.g. +2 turns a d6 into a d8.

scaleModifiers.Label: Scale value: dice modifiers
scaleModifiers.Tip: Dice modifiers for dice scale values, e.g. r=1 rerolls ones.

hiddenItems.Label: Hide items on the sheet
hiddenItems.Tip: An item ID, an identifier, or type:identifier such as spell:mage-hand.

name.Label: Actor name
name.Tip: {} stands for the current name. Changes the sheet's name, not the token's.

lightNegative.Label: Darkness instead of light
lightNegative.Tip: true turns the light into darkness, e.g. for a Darkness effect.

light.Label: Whole light configuration
light.Tip: Sets several light values at once with one JSON object.

References.Title: References
References.IntroActor: Click a reference to insert it into the value. Scale values show this character's current value.
References.IntroItem: Click a reference to insert it into the value. Open a class or subclass to see its scale values.

Scale.TypeMismatch: This is a {type} scale value, which this attribute doesn't fit. Pick the matching Scale value entry.
